Last ran Feb 25, 2026

Cell class numbers (glia and neurons, split by sex, and shown as a bar plot)

Load libraries
```{r setup}
library(BPCells)
library(sccomp)
library(readxl)
library(reticulate)
library(SingleCellExperiment)
library(zellkonverter)
library(khroma)
library(patchwork)
library(tidyverse)
```

Get numbers for our dataset
```{r}

# Step 1: Load necessary libraries
library(tidyverse)
library(ggsankeyfier)
library(BPCells)
library(ggrepel)
library(khroma)
library(ggalluvial)

# Load the final, post-QC matrix
post_qc_and_clustering_mat <- open_matrix_dir("../shared objs and code/post_qc_decontx_counts/")

# Load cell cluster assignments
neuronal_assignments <- readRDS("../shared objs and code/neuronal_number_ids_cluster_assignments.rds")
non_neuronal_assignments <- readRDS("../shared objs and code/non_neuronal_assignments.rds")

# Combine all assignments into a single dataframe
assignments_df <- data.frame(
  cluster = c(neuronal_assignments, non_neuronal_assignments),
  cell_id = c(names(neuronal_assignments), names(non_neuronal_assignments))
)

# Get the final number of cells that passed all filtering and clustering steps
num_cells_after_qc_and_clustering <- nrow(assignments_df)

# Load the conversion file for internal cluster IDs to official names
df_internal_and_official_name <- read_csv("../shared objs and code/internal_to_official_name_conversions_neuronal.csv")

# ---
# Step 3: Process and classify cell assignments
# ---

# Convert numeric neuronal cluster IDs to their official names
assignments_df <- assignments_df %>%
  mutate(cluster = case_when(
    cluster %in% df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id ~ df_internal_and_official_name$official_name[match(cluster, df_internal_and_official_name$numeric_id)],
    .default = cluster # Keep non-neuronal names as they are
  ))

# Add a 'cell_class' column (e.g., "neuronal", "astrocyte", "microglia")
assignments_df <- assignments_df %>%
  mutate(cell_class = case_when(
    cluster %in% df_internal_and_official_name$official_name ~ "neuronal",
    .default = sub("[-_].*", "", cluster) # For non-neuronal, take the part before the first '-' or '_'
  ))

assignments_df$cell_class %>% unique

```


Get metadata from Hajdarovic, Yu, et al (2022)
```{r}
webb_mouse = readRDS("../shared objs and code/external mouse datasets/webb seurat obj.RDS")
webb_mouse_meta = webb_mouse@meta.data
webb_mouse_meta$sex = "Female"
webb_mouse_meta$group %>% unique
glia_classes = webb_mouse_meta$group
  
```

Get meta from mouse hypomap Steuernagel, Lam et al (2022)
```{r}
# Use zellkonverter to read h5ad file
mouse_hypomap_sce <- readH5AD("../shared objs and code/external mouse datasets/mouse hyopmap.h5ad",use_hdf5 = TRUE)
# Extract metadata from SingleCellExperiment object
mouse_hypomap_meta <- colData(mouse_hypomap_sce) %>% as.data.frame()

```

Remove Erythrocyte + Pituitary gland cells from hypomap
```{r}
mouse_hypomap_meta = mouse_hypomap_meta %>% filter(cell_type != "pituitary gland cell") %>% filter(cell_type != "erythrocyte") %>% droplevels()
```


Create cross-dataset annotation mapping
```{r}
# Define consistent cross-dataset annotation mapping
# This creates a standardized naming scheme across all three datasets

# Ashley Webb lab cluster names -> cross_dset_annotation
webb_mouse_meta  = webb_mouse_meta %>% mutate(cross_dset_annotation = case_when(
   group == "Neuron" ~ "Neuron",
   group == "Oligodendrocyte" ~ "Oligodendrocyte", 
   group == "OPC" ~ "OPC",
   group == "Astrocyte" ~ "Astrocyte",
   group == "Microglia/Macrophage" ~ "Immune",
   group == "Tanycyte" ~ "Tanycyte",
   group == "Vascular and Leptomeningeal Cell" ~ "Vascular",
   group == "Pericyte/Endothelial Cell" ~ "Vascular",
   group == "Ependymocyte" ~ "Ependymal",
  .default = NA
))


# Mouse hypomap dataset  
mouse_hypomap_meta = mouse_hypomap_meta %>% mutate(
  cross_dset_annotation = case_when(
    cell_type == "neuron" ~ "Neuron",
    cell_type =="tanycyte" ~  "Tanycyte",
    cell_type =="astrocyte" ~  "Astrocyte", 
    cell_type =="oligodendrocyte" ~  "Oligodendrocyte",
    cell_type =="oligodendrocyte precursor cell" ~  "OPC",
    cell_type =="microglial cell" ~  "Immune",
    cell_type =="mural cell" ~  "Vascular",
    cell_type =="fibroblast" ~  "Vascular", # Group with vascular
    cell_type =="endothelial cell"~  "Vascular",
    cell_type =="ependymal cell"~  "Ependymal",
    cell_type =="hypendymal cell" ~  "Ependymal", #group hypendymal/epen
    .default = NA
  )
)

# Own dataset
assignments_df = assignments_df %>% mutate(
  cross_dset_annotation  = case_when( 
     cell_class == "neuronal" ~ "Neuron",
      cell_class == "vascular" ~ "Vascular", 
      cell_class == "olig" ~ "Oligodendrocyte",
      cell_class == "VLMC" ~ "Vascular", # Vascular and Leptomeningeal Cell
      cell_class == "bam" ~ "Immune", # Brain Associated Macrophage
      cell_class == "astrocyte" ~ "Astrocyte",
      cell_class == "ependymal" ~ "Ependymal",
      cell_class == "microglia" ~ "Immune", 
      cell_class == "opc" ~ "OPC",
      cell_class == "tanycyte" ~ "Tanycyte",
      cell_class == "tcells" ~ "Immune", # T cells
     .default = NA

  ))

#add dataset labels, and sex
mouse_hypomap_meta = mouse_hypomap_meta %>% 
  mutate(sex = case_when(
    sex == "female" ~ "Female",
    sex == "male" ~ "Male",
    sex == "unknown" ~ "Unknown",
    .default = NA
  ))

#get sex all aligned
mouse_hypomap_meta$sex = as.character(mouse_hypomap_meta$sex)


animal_metadata = readr::read_csv("../shared objs and code/mouse_meta.csv")
animal_metadata$ID = as.character(animal_metadata$ID)
animal_metadata = animal_metadata %>% dplyr::select("ID", "Sex", "Line.short", "Genotype", "Age (months)") %>% dplyr::rename("age" = "Age (months)","strain" = "Line.short", "sex" = "Sex", "genotype" = "Genotype", "animal_id" = "ID")
assignments_df$animal_id = gsub(".*_(\\d+)-.*", "\\1", assignments_df$cell_id)
assignments_df$sex = animal_metadata$sex[match(assignments_df$animal_id, animal_metadata$animal_id)]

#add dataset label
assignments_df$dataset = "This Study"
mouse_hypomap_meta$dataset = "Hypomap"
webb_mouse_meta$dataset = "Hajdarovic, Yu (Female Aging)"

assignments_df = assignments_df %>% select(dataset, cross_dset_annotation, sex)
mouse_hypomap_meta = mouse_hypomap_meta %>% select(dataset, cross_dset_annotation, sex)
webb_mouse_meta = webb_mouse_meta %>% select(dataset, cross_dset_annotation, sex)

#combine all metadata into one df
full_meta = bind_rows(assignments_df, mouse_hypomap_meta, webb_mouse_meta)

```

Create barplot counting cross_dset_annotation for each sex, colored by dataset
```{r}
# Create count data for the barplot
count_data <- full_meta %>%
  filter(!is.na(cross_dset_annotation) & !is.na(sex)) %>%
  count(dataset, sex, cross_dset_annotation) %>%
  group_by(sex, cross_dset_annotation) %>%
  mutate(total_count = sum(n)) %>%
  ungroup()

count_data$dataset <- factor(count_data$dataset,
                             levels = c("Hypomap",
                                        "This Study",
                                        "Hajdarovic, Yu (Female Aging)"))
# Create the barplot
p <- ggplot(count_data, aes(x = cross_dset_annotation, y = n, fill = dataset)) +
  geom_bar(stat = "identity", position = "dodge") +
  facet_wrap(~ sex, scales = "fixed") +
  labs(
    title = "Cell Class Counts by Sex",
    x = "Cell Class",
    y = "Number of Cells",
    fill = "Dataset"
  ) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 20,base_family = "Helvetica",) +
  theme(
    axis.text.x = element_text(angle = 45, hjust = 1,face = "bold"),
    plot.title = element_text(hjust = 0.5,face = "bold"),
    legend.position = "bottom"
  ) +
  scale_fill_okabeito() +
  scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma_format())

ggsave("./dataset cell class counts plot.pdf", p, width = 30, height = 20)
```
